readings.title: The East Gate and the Prince
readings.subtitle: A gate reserved for YeHoVaH and the prince.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 44:1] And <dn>He</dn> brought me back to the outer gate of the set-apart place which faces east, and it was shut. [2] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“This gate is shut, it is not opened, and no one enters it, because <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl has entered by it, and it shall be shut.</dq> [3] <dq>“The prince, as prince, he sits in it to eat <dn>את</dn> bread before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, coming in by way of the porch of the gate, and going out the same way.”</dq>

readings.title: Laws of the House
readings.subtitle: A rebuke for profaning the sanctuary with foreigners.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 44:4] And <dn>He</dn> brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the House. And <dn>I</dn> looked and saw the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> filled <dn>את</dn> the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and <dn>I</dn> fell on my face. [5] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“Son of man, set <dn>את</dn> your heart and see with your eyes and hear with your ears, <dn>את</dn> all that <dn>I</dn> say to you concerning all the laws of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and all its Torot. And you shall set <dn>את</dn> your heart to the entrance of the house, with <dn>את</dn> all the exits of the set-apart place,</dq> [6] <dq>and shall say to the rebellious, to the house of Yisra’ěl, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “O house of Yisra’ěl, enough of all these abominations of yours,</dq> [7] <dq>that you brought in sons of a foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in <dn>My</dn> set-apart place to profane it, <dn>My</dn> house! That you brought near <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> food, the fat and the blood, and you broke <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> covenant because of all your abominations.</dq> [8] <dq>“And you did not guard <dn>את</dn> the charge of that which is set-apart to <dn>Me</dn>, but you have set others to guard <dn>את</dn> the charge of <dn>My</dn> set-apart place for you.”</dq> [9] <dq>Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “No son of a foreigner, uncircumcised in heart or uncircumcised in flesh, comes into <dn>My</dn> set-apart place, even any son of a foreigner who is among the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq>

readings.title: The Unfaithful Levites
readings.subtitle: Their punishment for idolatry is a demotion in service.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 44:10] <dq>“And the Lěvites who went far from <dn>Me</dn>, when Yisra’ěl went astray, who strayed away from <dn>Me</dn> after their idols, they shall bear <dn>את</dn> their crookedness.</dq> [11] <dq>“And they were attendants in <dn>My</dn> set-apart place, as gatekeepers of the house and attendants of the house, slaying <dn>את</dn> the ascending offering and <dn>את</dn> the slaughtering for the people, and standing before them to attend to them.</dq> [12] <dq>“Because they attended to them before their idols and became a stumbling-block of crookedness to the house of Yisra’ěl, therefore <dn>I</dn> have lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath against them,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“that they shall bear <dn>את</dn> their crookedness,</dq> [13] <dq>and not come near <dn>Me</dn> to serve as <dn>My</dn> priest, nor come near any of that which is set-apart to <dn>Me</dn>, nor into the Most Set-apart Place. And they shall bear <dn>את</dn> their shame and <dn>את</dn> their abominations which they have done.</dq> [14] <dq>“Yet <dn>I</dn> shall make them those who guard <dn>את</dn> the duty of the House, for all its work, and for all that has to be done in it.</dq>

readings.title: The Faithful Zadokite Priests
readings.subtitle: Their faithfulness is rewarded with privileged service.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 44:15] <dq>“But the priests, the Lěvites, the sons of Tsaḏoq, who guarded <dn>את</dn> the duty of <dn>My</dn> set-apart place when the children of Yisra’ěl went astray from <dn>Me</dn>, they shall draw near to <dn>Me</dn> to serve <dn>Me</dn>, and shall stand before <dn>Me</dn> to bring to <dn>Me</dn> <dn>את</dn> the fat and <dn>את</dn> the blood,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [16] <dq>“They shall enter <dn>My</dn> set-apart place, and they shall draw near to <dn>My</dn> table to serve <dn>Me</dn>, and they shall guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> charge.</dq> [17] <dq>“And it shall be, when they enter the gates of the inner courtyard, that they put on linen garments, and no wool shall come upon them while they attend within the gates of the inner courtyard or within the house.</dq> [18] <dq>“They shall have linen turbans on their heads and linen trousers on their bodies, they shall not gird themselves with sweat.</dq> [19] <dq>“And when they go out to the outer courtyard, to the outer courtyard to the people, they shall take off <dn>את</dn> their garments in which they have attended, and shall leave them in the set-apart rooms, and shall put on other garments, and they shall set-apart <dn>את</dn> the people in their garments.</dq>

readings.title: Regulations for Priestly Conduct
readings.subtitle: Rules concerning appearance, marriage, teaching, and purity.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 44:20] <dq>“And their heads they shall not shave, nor shall they let their hair grow long – they shall keep their hair well trimmed.</dq> [21] <dq>“And no priest is to drink wine when he comes into the inner court.</dq> [22] <dq>“And they do not take as wife a widow or a divorced woman, but take maidens of the seed of the house of Yisra’ěl, or widows of priests.</dq> [23] <dq>“And they are to teach <dn>My</dn> people <dn>את</dn> the difference between the set-apart and the profane, and make them know what is unclean and clean.</dq> [24] <dq>“And they are to stand as judges in a dispute, and judge it according to <dn>My</dn> right-rulings. And they are to guard <dn>My</dn> Torot and <dn>My</dn> laws in all <dn>My</dn> appointed times, and set apart <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths.</dq> [25] <dq>“And they are not to defile themselves by coming near a dead man. Only for a father or mother, for a son or daughter, for a brother or unmarried sister they defile themselves.</dq> [26] <dq>“And after his cleansing, they count seven days for him,</dq> [27] <dq>and on the day that he comes into the inner court of the set-apart place to attend in the set-apart place, he brings <dn>את</dn> his sin offering,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Priests' Inheritance
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH Himself is their portion and possession.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 44:28] <dq>“And it shall be to them for an inheritance, <dn>I</dn> am their inheritance. And you give them no possession in Yisra’ěl – <dn>I</dn> am their possession.</dq> [29] <dq>“The grain offering, and the sin offering, and the guilt offering they are to eat, and all that is dedicated in Yisra’ěl is theirs.</dq> [30] <dq>“And the first of all the first-fruits of all, and every contribution of all, of all your contributions, belong to the priests. And the first of your ground meal you give to the priest, so that a blessing rests on your house.</dq> [31] <dq>“The priests are not to eat any bird or beast found dead or torn to pieces.</dq>

readings.title: The Sacred Portion of Land
readings.subtitle: Divisions for the sanctuary, priests, Levites, city, and prince.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 45:1] <dq>“And when you divide <dn>את</dn> the land by lot into inheritance, offer a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, a set-apart portion of the land, in length twenty-five thousand cubits long, and in width ten thousand, this being set-apart throughout its border all around.</dq> [2] <dq>“Of this a square plot is to be for the set-apart place, five hundred by five hundred, with fifty cubits around it for an open space.</dq> [3] <dq>“And from this measure you are to measure: twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand wide. And in it is to be the set-apart place, the Most Set-apart Place.</dq> [4] <dq>“This is to be a set-apart portion of the land, belonging to the priests, the attendants of the set-apart place, who draw near to serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And it shall be a place for their houses and set-apart ground for the set-apart place.</dq> [5] <dq>“And twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width is for the Lěvites, the attendants of the House, for them for a possession, twenty rooms.</dq> [6] <dq>“And give the city as possession: five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, beside the contribution of the set-apart portion – it belongs to all the house of Yisra’ěl.</dq> [7] <dq>“And the prince is to have a portion on one side and the other of the set-apart contribution and of the possession of the city. And bordering on the set-apart contribution and the possession of the city, on the west side westward and on the east side eastward, and the length alongside one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.</dq> [8] <dq>“Of the land this is his possession in Yisra’ěl, and <dn>My</dn> princes shall no longer oppress <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> people. And they shall give <dn>את</dn> the land to the house of Yisra’ěl, according to their tribes.”</dq>

readings.title: A Call for Just Rulers
readings.subtitle: Princes are commanded to use just weights and measures.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 45:9] <dq>Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Enough, you princes of Yisra’ěl! Put away violence and plundering, and do right-ruling and righteousness, and stop your evictions of <dn>My</dn> people,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [10] <dq>“Have right scales, and a right ěphah, and a right bath.</dq> [11] <dq>“Let the ěphah and the bath be of the same measure, so that the bath contains one-tenth of a ḥomer, and the ěphah one-tenth of a ḥomer. Let their measure be according to the ḥomer.</dq> [12] <dq>“And the sheqel is twenty gěrahs. Your mina is twenty sheqels, twenty-five sheqels, fifteen sheqels.</dq>

readings.title: Contributions and the Prince's Duties
readings.subtitle: The people are to provide contributions for the prince to administer the offerings.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 45:13] <dq>“This is the contribution which you present: you shall give one-sixth of an ěphah from a ḥomer of wheat, and one-sixth of an ěphah from a ḥomer of barley.</dq> [14] <dq>“And the law concerning oil, the bath of oil, is one-tenth of a bath from a kor. A kor is a ḥomer or ten baths, for ten baths are a ḥomer.</dq> [15] <dq>“And one lamb from a flock, from two hundred, from the watered pastures of Yisra’ěl, for grain offerings, and for an ascending offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [16] <dq>“All the people of the land are to give <dn>את</dn> this contribution to the prince in Yisra’ěl.</dq> [17] <dq>“And on the prince are the ascending offerings, and the grain offerings, and drink offerings, at the festival, the new moons, the sabbaths – in all the appointed times of the house of Yisra’ěl. <dn>He</dn> is to prepare <dn>את</dn> the sin offering, and <dn>את</dn> the grain offering, and <dn>את</dn> the ascending offering, and <dn>את</dn> the peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Yisra’ěl.”</dq>

readings.title: Regulations for Appointed Times
readings.subtitle: Specific offerings for cleansing the sanctuary and for the Passover.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 45:18] <dq>Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “In the first month, on the first of the new moon, you are to take a young bull, a perfect one, and shall cleanse <dn>את</dn> the set-apart place.</dq> [19] <dq>“And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the House, on the four corners of the ledge of the slaughter-place, and on the posts of the gate of the inner courtyard.</dq> [20] <dq>“And do the same on the seventh of the new moon for anyone who makes a mistake or is foolish. And you shall make atonement for the House.</dq> [21] <dq>“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the new moon, you have the Pěsaḥ, a festival of seven days, unleavened bread is eaten.</dq> [22] <dq>“And on that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.</dq> [23] <dq>“And during the seven days of the festival he prepares an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, seven bulls and seven rams, perfect ones, daily for seven days, and a male goat daily for a sin offering.</dq> [24] <dq>“And he prepares a grain offering of one ěphah for each bull and one ěphah for each ram, together with a hin of oil for each ěphah.</dq> [25] <dq>“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the new moon, at the festival, he prepares like these seven days, as the sin offering, as the ascending offering, as the grain offering, and as the oil.”</dq>

readings.title: Worship on Sabbaths and New Moons
readings.subtitle: The east gate of the inner court is opened for worship on special days.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 46:1] <dq>‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “The gate of the inner courtyard facing east is shut the six days of work, but on the sabbath it is opened, and on the day of the new moon it is opened.</dq> [2] <dq>“And the prince shall enter by way of the porch of that gate from the outside, and he shall stand by the post. And the priests shall prepare <dn>את</dn> his ascending offering and <dn>את</dn> his peace offerings. And he shall bow himself at the threshold of the gate, and shall go out, but the gate is not shut until evening.</dq> [3] <dq>“And the people of the land shall also bow themselves at the entrance to this gate before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, on the sabbaths and on the new moons.</dq> [4] <dq>“And the ascending offering which the prince brings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on the sabbath day is six lambs, perfect ones, and a ram, a perfect one.</dq> [5] <dq>“And the grain offering is one ěphah for a ram, and the grain offering for the lambs, a gift of his hand, and a hin of oil for an ěphah.</dq> [6] <dq>“And on the day of the new moon: a young bull, a perfect one, six lambs, and a ram, they should be perfect.</dq> [7] <dq>“And he prepares a grain offering of an ěphah for a bull, and an ěphah for a ram, and for the lambs as his hand attains, and a hin of oil for an ěphah.</dq> [8] <dq>“And when the prince enters, he comes in by way of the porch of that gate, and goes out the same way.</dq>

readings.title: Regulations for Worship and Offerings
readings.subtitle: The flow of people during festivals and the continual daily offering.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 46:9] <dq>“And when the people of the land enter before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at the appointed times, whoever shall enter by way of the north gate to bow himself, goes out by way of the south gate. And whoever enters by way of the south gate, goes out by way of the north gate, he shall not return by way of the gate through which he came, but goes out through the opposite one.</dq> [10] <dq>“And the prince is to be in their midst, entering when they enter, and going out when they go out.</dq> [11] <dq>“And in the festivals and in the appointed times the grain offering is an ěphah for a bull, and an ěphah for a ram, and for lambs the gift of his hand, and a hin of oil for an ěphah.</dq> [12] <dq>“And when the prince makes a spontaneous ascending offering or spontaneous peace offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the gate facing east shall be opened for him. And he shall prepare <dn>את</dn> his ascending offering and <dn>את</dn> his peace offerings as he did on the Sabbath day. And he shall go out, and after he goes out the gate shall be shut.</dq> [13] <dq>“And make a daily ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of a lamb a year old, a perfect one, preparing it morning by morning.</dq> [14] <dq>“And prepare a grain offering with it morning by morning, a sixth of an ěphah, and a third of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour, a grain offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – continual everlasting laws.</dq> [15] <dq>“And prepare <dn>את</dn> the lamb, and <dn>את</dn> the grain offering, and <dn>את</dn> the oil, morning by morning, a continual ascending offering.”</dq>

readings.title: The Prince's Inheritance
readings.subtitle: Laws governing the prince's gifts to his sons and servants.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 46:16] <dq>Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “When the prince gives a gift of some of his inheritance to any of his sons, it belongs to his sons, it is their possession by inheritance.</dq> [17] <dq>“And when he gives a gift of some of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his till the year of release, then it shall return to the prince. Only the inheritance of his sons is theirs.</dq> [18] <dq>“And the prince does not take any of the people’s inheritance by evicting them from their possession. <dn>He</dn> is to give his sons their inheritance from his own possession, so that none of <dn>My</dn> people are separated from his possession.” ’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Temple Kitchens
readings.subtitle: Specific locations for the priests and attendants to cook the offerings.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 46:19] And he brought me through the entrance, which was at the side of the gate, into the set-apart rooms of the priests facing north. And look, there was a place at the extreme rear toward the west. [20] And he said to me, “This is the place where the priests cook <dn>את</dn> the guilt offering and <dn>את</dn> the sin offering, where they bake <dn>את</dn> the grain offering, so as not to bring them out into the outer courtyard to set the people apart.” [21] And he brought me out into the outer courtyard and made me pass along to the four corners of the courtyard. And look, in every corner of the courtyard was another courtyard. [22] In the four corners of the courtyard were courtyards covered over, forty cubits long and thirty wide, these four corners having one measure, [23] and a row of building stones all around in them, all around the four of them, and places for fire were made under the rows, all around. [24] And he said to me, “These are the kitchens where the attendants of the House cook <dn>את</dn> the slaughterings of the people.”
